role: multi-window and multi-monitor semantic routing policy
invariant: Physical OS/browser windows remain rectangular screen regions. Non-Cartesian coordinates are semantic workspace/layout coordinates only and never alter scientific truth, module math, evidence, or proof state unless an explicit scientific transform module is present.
routing_pipeline: derive WindowIntent from source experiment/node/object and requested view role
apply explicit user pin/lock/monitor preference first
select semantic workspace and coordinate geometry
compute semantic anchor from dependency/role/heartbeat/evidence relationships
choose target monitor/workspace based on available area, focus, role and user preferences
project semantic anchor into rectangular screen/window bounds
resolve collisions/occlusion while minimizing movement from prior stable positions
animate transition without changing experiment semantics
persist layout state separately from scientific experiment semantics
restore deterministically when screen topology is compatible; gracefully remap otherwise

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Hybrid semantic atlas
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: OS windows stay rectangular while CACE assigns semantic locations using a pluggable geometry per workspace.
best_for: switching geometries without moving scientific state
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Requires a clean projection layer and separation of visual layout from scientific semantics.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Hexagonal axial/cube coordinates
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Place related modules/views on a six-neighbor lattice with lower directional bias than square grids.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Outer physical windows still project to rectangles; hex cells are semantic anchors.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Radial / polar orbit layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Put the active experiment/view at the center and arrange related inspectors, evidence, help, AI, and provenance on rings.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Can become crowded when many items share the same radius.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Hyperbolic / Poincare focus-context layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Map deep dependency/research hierarchies into finite screen space while expanding the active focus.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Users need orientation cues, smooth transitions, breadcrumbs and a stable home/focus anchor.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Voronoi / weighted power-cell layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Allocate polygonal semantic regions according to priority, attention, compute load, heartbeat or user-defined importance.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Frequent weight changes can destroy spatial memory; use hysteresis and user pins.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Hilbert/Morton locality-preserving address layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Map high-dimensional semantic addresses into a stable one-dimensional ordering that can be tiled over screens/workspaces.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Excellent machine locality but less immediately intuitive to humans; expose breadcrumbs and region labels.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Simplex / barycentric layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Position views according to relative weights among three or more scientific criteria.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Only meaningful when axes/vertices have a clear interpretation.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Gaussian/Eisenstein complex lattice
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Use complex-integer or omega-based lattices as semantic addressing and tiling systems.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Must remain visualization/addressing unless an explicit scientific transform is inserted; provide a Cartesian projection/reference.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Fractal / recursive address space
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Represent experiment families as recursive tiles or addresses so zooming reveals finer windows/modules.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Navigation history, zoom breadcrumbs and stable parent/child identity are essential.

ranked_geometry_modes.name: Spherical / 3D shell layout
ranked_geometry_modes.summary: Place views around a central focus in 3D with orbit/rotation controls.
ranked_geometry_modes.caution: Not the default desktop layout; depth/occlusion and accessibility costs are high.

routing_objectives: preserve user pins and explicit placements
preserve spatial memory by minimizing unnecessary movement
keep contextual windows near their source without covering it
keep proof/evidence/provenance views close to the result they explain
route low-priority/background windows toward peripheral regions
avoid monitor changes unless benefit exceeds movement cost
keep window location deterministic for the same semantic state when possible

role_defaults.proof_evidence: near source result or dedicated evidence monitor
role_defaults.provenance: near proof/evidence but lower visual priority
role_defaults.help: contextual peripheral window or user-selected monitor
role_defaults.local_ai: contextual peripheral window; never proof/evidence authority

multi_monitor.physical_model: rectangular screens in ordinary OS/browser coordinate space
default_assignment: additional monitor: 3D visualization, research dashboard, heartbeat/economy, logs according to user preference
multi_monitor.screen_change_rule: If a monitor disappears or resolution/DPI changes, preserve semantic coordinates and remap only the physical projection.

saved_fields: physical bounds as a restore hint
persistence.rule: Changing window geometry/layout never invalidates scientific caches or evidence.

public_help_boundary: Customer help may explain geometry choices and routing behavior but must not reveal proprietary optimization coefficients, custom CACE mathematical derivations, or internal scoring implementation.
